what: Each line of the vertical calligraphy title is covered by a background-color mask. When the Section head reaches the 20% line from the top of the screen, the masks fold up around their bottom edge over .75s power4.out (scaleY 1 → 0), revealing the lines from the top in a .5s stagger. Plays once.

options.dur: Time for the cover to fold away (s), default .75
options.delay: Start delay (seconds), default 0 — in the original story section it starts .5s later while the heading rises over 1.25s
options.start: ScrollTrigger start (relative to this element), default top 20% — the original brand section uses top 30%
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”, default power4.out
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to reveal (multiple children) — vertical-writing text · images. The mask part creates one per line
options.--fx-mask: Cover color (css), default background color at 96%

use: Vertical first lineVertical second line

from.where: index.html .gg-story · .gg-brand · .gg-profile vertical titles — original maskOff effect (gsap.to scaleY 0 · .75s power4.out · stagger .5, section top 20% · 30% · 0%)
